Paragraph: "On seeing those two great mighty ones that monkey has not even made-up his mind steadfast as he is very much frightened, and his heart is really sunken..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Severe fear causes cognitive indecisiveness and emotional sinking.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva struggles to make a steadfast decision due to overwhelming fright.
Outcome/Resolution: His internal resolve collapses, leading to a sunken heart and panic.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Bhaya (Profound fear that paralyzes steadfast conviction and clear judgment)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Fear creates a veil that sinks the heart and prevents clear discernment of supreme truth.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Cognitive paralysis: panic interfering with decision-making capacity and causing affective deflation.
